ble_client_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the `ble_client` entry associated with the device.

*See also: [AM43 Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/am43#configuration-variables)*

invert_position.docs:
**boolean**: Inverts the position value to and from the device. Set if ESPHome is swapping around the open/close state of the cover.

*See also: [AM43 Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/am43#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**int**: The pin for the device, as set in the app. The default is usually printed on the device. Defaults to `8888`.

*See also: [AM43 Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/am43#configuration-variables)*

battery_level.docs:
The information for the battery level sensor.

*See also: [AM43 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/am43#configuration-variables)*

ble_client_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the `ble_client` entry associated with the device.

*See also: [AM43 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/am43#configuration-variables)*

illuminance.docs:
The information for the light level sensor.

*See also: [AM43 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/am43#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [AM43 Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/am43#configuration-variables)*
